newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee gains amid dollar sales.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee gains amid dollar sales.

text.p: The Sri Lankan rupee closed higher against the dollar on Monday with a foreign bank selling greenbacks, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 58.82 to the dollar, after opening at 58.92, they said.
"The day's activity was limited to one bank selling dollars," said a HongKong Bank dealer.
"There wasn't enough trade-backed transactions to make an impact," he added.
The Central Bank pushed up the dollar by four local cents on its overseas strength, fixind buying and selling prices at 58.7788 and 59.6672.
Overnight call money closed at 9.75 percent after opening at 10.75. The Central Bank overnight repo rate remained at 8.5 percent.
